plugins.name: GGPK Explorer
plugins.author: POEFixer
plugins.description: Browses the game's content files: searchable file tree, viewers for tables, images, models and audio, and file extraction.
changes: Extracting folders and selections is several times faster (it reads whole bundles at once and writes with up to four threads), and a Cancel button in the toolbar stops a running extraction.
Save As converts textures to PNG and tables to JSON/CSV on several CPU cores, with its own Cancel button.
Find in Files, Replace in Files and Find references in the table viewer run much faster; replacing no longer freezes the window.
Expand All on a large folder no longer freezes the window.
Fixed crashes when loading, unloading or reloading (F5) during an extraction, export or search, and when a search used an invalid "\x" escape.
Folders with non-English names work for opening and extracting. Empty files are extracted, long output paths work, and failed writes are reported.
A file replaced with an empty one reads back correctly straight away, not only after the next save.
The replace preview no longer skips files inside collapsed folders.
The game path is pre-filled from the program's general settings when Smoother has none.
.aoc files open in the same Model view as meshes: the main model with its skeleton and animations. The Text tab is unchanged.
The 3D view is simpler: diffuse textures, one light, Solid/Wire, Grid, Bones, Follow and the animation panel. Lights, sounds, particles, states, sockets and attachments are removed.
The model view says what is missing (the mesh data, a parent of an .aoc, the skeleton) instead of showing an empty view, and saving an .aoc in the Text tab keeps the camera and the selected clip.
The Info tab shows a short summary with a Copy button.
Lighter: no shadow pass every frame, and the plugin DLL is about 15% smaller.

plugins.name: Quick Stash
plugins.author: Omer Faruk ARPA, POEFixer
plugins.description: One-click Transfer from your backpack into the open stash, vendor or trade window, and TAKE from the stash by the game's own item search.
changes: TAKE now takes exactly the items the game outlines: it reads the game's own result of the Highlight Items search, so item level, rarity, properties (Quality, Armour, Energy Shield...), requirements and the game's filters (`ilvl:80`, `tier:15`, `loc:3,5`) all work, in your game's language. New setting "Take exactly what the game outlines" (on by default); the "How it works" card shows whether the game's highlight or Quick Stash's own search decided.

When the game's result cannot be read (for example right after a game patch), Quick Stash's own search is used. It now also finds the rarity, item level, waystone tier and level requirement lines (`Rarity: Rare`, `Item Level: 82`, `Requires: Level 80`), `unidentified`, `ilvl:80` and `tier:15`, and checks each search word line by line like the game.
The Diagnostics report shows, for every item, the game's own highlight state and search text next to Quick Stash's.

plugins.name: Radar

changes: No longer switched off by the program as too slow, and no frame-rate drop with the large map open: the radar reads only the monsters, NPCs, chests and area transitions it draws instead of every object in the area (thousands on a map).
Fewer walkable dots: at least 12 pixels apart, at most 20,000 per frame, thinned evenly when the map is zoomed out.

plugins.name: Ritual Helper
plugins.author: Omer Faruk ARPA, POEFixer
plugins.description: Highlights the Ritual rewards you want in the Favours window, shows their prices and defers them all with one click.
changes: The defer hourglass is found at every screen size: it was missed at 1080p, 2160p and most other sizes, so DEFER asked to switch defer mode on by hand. DEFER switches it on by itself again.
With POEFixer 365 or later the Favours window's buttons are found by the game's own element names, the same in every game language.

DEFER checks defer mode again right after you press it: when defer mode was switched on by hand and went off at the press, DEFER switches it back on before clicking a reward (or stops without clicking one when the hourglass is not found). This fixes "Stopped: defer mode turned off".
The DEFER button is never drawn over the game's hourglass or the reroll button; a long label at a large font size is drawn smaller.
DEFER clicks nothing when the rewards changed around the press (a reroll or a refresh from the server) and asks you to press it again, instead of clicking where other rewards now are.
A deferral that worked no longer ends with "Stopped: defer mode turned off" when the game leaves defer mode right after the confirming click.
Safer clicking: a reward or the confirming button is clicked only right after the window was read again, so a refresh from the server that ends defer mode is seen before the click.
The discovery dump lists each element's control name and the window's buttons found by name.

plugins.name: Tablet Reforge
plugins.author: v1sualxD, Omer Faruk ARPA, POEFixer
plugins.description: Runs the tablet reforge cycle: takes tablets from your stash, reforges trios at the Reforging Bench and puts the results back.
changes: The cycle no longer stops at the stash with "POEFixer cannot tell which stash tab is active" when your Tablet stash tab is selected and its Tablets subtab is shown. On some stashes POEFixer cannot tell which stash tab is shown (seen with many tabs, "(Unavailable)" tabs and the tab list expanded): the cycle now clicks your Tablet stash tab and, once that click went through, goes on as soon as it sees the Tablets subtab with its tablet grid, or selects the Tablets subtab when another subtab is shown. For the rest of the stash visit it works only in that Tablets subtab and does not click the tab again; when another tab (or another Fragment tab) is shown meanwhile, it clicks your Tablet stash tab again and goes on only once that same Tablets subtab is back. It clicks the tab 8 times at most per stash visit, then stops and asks you to check the "Tablet stash tab" setting. When your Tablet stash tab is not on screen to be clicked, the cycle still looks for its Tablets subtab and, if it is not shown, stops after a moment with a line saying so instead of waiting 20 seconds. No tablet is clicked before the Tablets subtab and its page are found, as before.

While POEFixer cannot tell which stash tab is shown, a stash tab or tab list entry that you named "Tablets" is never taken for the Tablets subtab of your Fragment stash tab, also with the tab list expanded.
A Diagnostics recording now lists every stash tab POEFixer sees (its name, whether it is the shown one, whether it is on screen), so a report shows what the plugin saw.
